clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, you search the Flintridge belongings for clues to Stalvan Mistmantle. Sealed crates by the canals hold the household’s remaining possessions, while restless spirits tied to the massacre guard what remains.

You trace Stalvan’s path from Duskwood to Stormwind. Beside the city canals, Caretaker Folsom watches over what remains of the Flintridge household. His father served the estate before him and had to mop up blood after a massacre that claimed the household. The name Stalvan is somehow tied to that slaughter.

The Flintridge trust funds are gone, and royal tax collectors press the estate. Its surviving heirlooms and packed belongings are sealed inside shipping crates along the canal embankment, awaiting auction. You search the boxes for Stalvan’s trail before the family’s remaining goods are scattered to collectors across the kingdom.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My father was the caretaker of the estate long before I was. He had to mop the blood up after the massacre. But that's neither here nor there.

The last funds of the Flintridge trust have dried up. Now the last of the family possessions are headed for auction. Blame the tax vultures. I guess if you're really itching to learn more you're free to look through this junk. Who knows what you might find.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You slowly slide the lid of the crate off....
